ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white regions on the lateral lobes to a low-intensity black central region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones on the distal portions of the left and right lobes. These are bisected by a thick, vertical low-intensity black band originating from the peduncle and flaring slightly toward the notch. Transition zones exhibit high-frequency pixel mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an acute angle of approximately 40 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within the central bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits higher pixel-amplitude variations and coarser indentations compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a primary convex curve from the median notch toward the distal tips, with the outer tips exhibiting a secondary concave hook or posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark punctate pixels (rosettes) are visible on the white ventral surface of both lobes, primarily concentrated near the interior black/white interface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel streaks (rake marks) are detected on the left lobe, cutting across the primary white pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textural irregularity and potential tissue loss at the distal tip of the right lobe; numerous small-scale nicks and irregular peaks along the trailing edge of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'feathered' or 'spray' pixel patterns at the inner margins of the white lobes where they meet the central black pigmentation.
